entities.summary: David Schuller is an Austrian ice hockey player who is currently an unrestricted free agent who most recently played for HC TWK Innsbruck of the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL). On June 13, 2015, he joined Innsbruck after spending the majority of his career with EC KAC, agreeing to a one-year deal.
